definition:
flowchart LR
  Start([Request]) --> Auth[Authenticate]
  Auth --> Cache{Cache hit?}
  Cache -->|hit| Serve[Serve cached]
  Cache -->|miss| Fetch[Fetch from origin]
  Fetch --> Store[(Write cache)]
  Store --> Serve
  Serve --> Done([Response])
intent: NO COLORS SPECIFIED AT ALL - the control/baseline for this wave. Byte-identical graph to w3-09, w3-10 and w3-14 with every classDef/style/linkStyle removed, so the engine's OWN defaults are the only thing painting. Establishes what 'correct' looks like for this graph in each theme and isolates how much of any w3-09/10/14 failure is caused by the user's palette versus by the engine's default palette. If this baseline itself fails a theme, every hardcoded-palette verdict in the wave has to be read against that.
